svg.title: How long until the chat shows something
svg.desc: Log-scale dot plot. Real model time to first token: 20 runs from 1.3 to 8.6 seconds; full answer 3.3 to 8.7 seconds. Scripted first chunk: 60 runs from 1.6 to 13.7 milliseconds. Scripted turn done with delays off: 21 milliseconds to 1.1 seconds, the longest set by scripted tool sleeps. Scripted turn done at the default 50 millisecond pacing: 0.36 to 17.4 seconds; the long recorded answer took 17.4 seconds, slower than the real model that wrote it.

g.text: How long until the chat shows something
Every run as a dot, log scale. Real model: 20 calls. Scripted: 6 flows × 5 runs at each transport delay.
delays off (CI); scripted tool sleeps remain
the long recorded answer: 17.4 s, slower than the model that wrote it
